title: Powerball Odds Got 67% Worse
hook: Powerball Odds Worsened 67% After The Rules Changed
closing: The jackpot grew because the chance of winning moved farther away.
question: Would you still buy a ticket?

segments.say: Powerball odds are 1 in 292 million, making a lifetime lightning strike far likelier than the jackpot.
A royal flush is about 1 in 650,000, still hundreds of times likelier than winning Powerball.
Powerball odds worsened 67% after the rule change, trading harder wins for larger jackpots.
